title: unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-enhancements
author: Ava Chen
description: Context: Our unified rollouts surface has matured but we observed two pain points during recent canary/A-B/shadow rollouts: (1) noisy false-positive metric triggers when multiple correlated metrics briefly spike during infra maintenance, causing unnecessary auto-rollbacks; (2) lack of a lightweight, low-latency sampling path for shadow traffic that prevents stable end-to-end tracing for up-to-date model variants. This PR implements a set of enhancements: 1) composite metric quorum and temporal smoothing for auto-rollback decisions to reduce noise sensitivity; 2) a fast-path shadow sampler that attaches minimal headers and emits a condensed trace/span set to the telemetry pipeline to enable per-request correlation without blowing up trace volume; 3) observability additions (new rollback_reason tags, rollout_event logs, and dashboards) and 4) e2e stability tests that exercise canary -> weighted A/B -> shadow promotion with induced noise scenarios. Motivation: reduce unnecessary rollbacks, improve signal-to-noise for rollback decisions, and make shadow traffic observable with minimal overhead. Checklist: - [x] Implement composite metric quorum logic in rollout engine - [x] Add temporal smoothing window and outlier suppression - [x] Implement fast-path shadow sampler + minimal tracing headers - [x] Emit rollback_reason metric and rollout_event logs - [x] Add unit tests for quorum logic - [x] Add e2e tests simulating infra noise and verify stability guards - [x] Update docs and rollout migration guide Changeset summary: commits: 5, changed files: 12, ~1.2k additions, 432 deletions. See commits, changed_files, and CI checks below for details.

review_comments: Diego Martinez (request changes): The quorum algorithm looks reasonable, but I think we should expose the smoothing window as a rollout-level override and have a conservative default. Also we should guard the fast-path sampler to avoid leaking PII in headers.

Ava Chen (response): Added rollout-level override, default remains 30s window with exponential backoff on re-eval. Fast-path headers are opaque IDs only; expanded tests to verify no user-identifiable fields are forwarded.
Priya Nair (comment): Observability additions look good. Can we add a dashboard panel showing 'quorum_decision_latency' so we can detect slow evaluations?
Ava Chen (response): Added panel and metric emit for quorum_decision_latency. Adjusted e2e to validate expected latency under load.
Liam O'Connor (approve): Verified unit tests and ran e2e locally with the noise scenario. No regressions in latency for normal traffic; auto-rollbacks reduced on noisy periods as expected. Approving.

Security Scan: pass (no secrets, approved dependencies)
release_notes: Enhancements to unified rollouts: composite metric quorum with temporal smoothing for more robust auto-rollbacks; fast-path shadow sampler for low-overhead tracing of shadowed requests; observability additions (rollback_reason metric, rollout_event logs, quorum_decision_latency panel); e2e stability tests for noisy infra scenarios. No breaking changes for existing rollout configs; recommended default thresholds included in migration guide.
notes: Deployment: rollout-engine and telemetry must be deployed together due to new rollout_event contract. Migration: existing rollouts will inherit conservative defaults; teams can opt-in to quorum-based autorollback in rollout spec. Monitoring: add rollout_event and rollback_reason to alerting rules if desired.
